Problem: leadership + most of our east-coast sales engineering crew will be at re:Invent travel during Nov 28–30 and we also have the year-end maintenance/ops freeze kicking in mid-December that constrains follow-ups.

Options I see:
- Offer alternative week (Dec 7–9) where engineering coverage is better.
- Run the demo the week of Nov 29 but have a recorded deep-dive and one backup presenter (Prio) for high-level Q&A.
- Offer a split: product walkthrough now with AE + recorded engineering deep-dive delivered later.

Can each of you confirm availability / preference? If we push, I'll offer two concrete slots and a Calendly link. Also attaching a quick CSV of backup presenters (names and timezone availability).

Thanks — Michael
